title: Print in Reverse
description: Given a pointer to the head of a singly-linked list, print each data value from the reversed list. If the given list is empty, do not print anything.
input_format:
The first line of input contains t, the number of test cases.

The input of each test case is as follows:

- The first line contains an integer n, the number of elements in the list.
- Each of the next *n* lines contains a data element for a list node.
output_format: For each test case, print the data values of the linked list in reverse order, one per line.
constraints: 1 <= list[i] <= 1000, where list[i] is the i^th element in the list.
